items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1962-02-10
items.q: And as I said before, I owe everything to my first teacher.

ctx.x: Is there anything else that you'd like to add about your life in music? Any advice that you'd have for any younger musicians coming up?

Well, it takes a lot of study, I can say that. But the young people don't want to study. That's right. They want to begin playing right away. But I still like that method of catechism and written work and all those sort of things. And when you're learning music. It has paid off for me. I wouldn't give anything for it. But of course the music pupils of today want to go right to the piano and begin playing. But how are you going to play if you don't know the basic things about music? So my advice would be to learn…
And what is her name again now? Mrs. Stewart. What was her first name? Anna. Anna Stewart. And she's still living in New Orleans.
